arch: target-based CMake, one lib per directory - no global includes
executable thin over tested libs - logic never lives in main
concepts and ranges for generic code - constrain templates early
description: Write modern C++ (17/20) with RAII, smart pointers, and const-correctness. Use for any C++ code or review.
idioms: RAII for every resource, smart pointers by default
string_view and span for non-owning views
name: cpp-code
pitfalls: slicing via value polymorphism - use references
exceptions across module boundaries - document the contract
style: braced init, auto only when type is obvious
testing: Catch2 or GTest; sanitizers asan plus ubsan in CI.
triggers: setting up CMake builds, clang-tidy, or sanitizers
